meta.title: BEACH FRONT HOTELS in Da Nang, Vietnam | Budget & Luxury Hotel Review
meta.description:
Where to stay in Da Nang.
Today we will look out for more hotels in Da Nang, Vietnam.
All from budget friendly beachfront hotels tp high end modern penthouse suites!
While i think staying at the An Thuong area is better for longterm those Da Nang beach front sea view hotels in Son Tra might be worth considering.
The last two Hotel rooftops are amazing an also worth checking out for dinner right at the beach.
We will like always check out their spas and restaurants as well!

Where would you stay?
